questions.section_heading_before: 四、解答题（19题12分，20题14分，共26分）
questions.question_markdown:
19. （12分）
如图，$PA\perp$ 平面 $ABCD$，四边形 $ABCD$ 为矩形，$PA=AB=2$，$AD=4$，点 $F$ 是 $PB$ 的中点，点 $E$ 在边 $BC$ 上移动。
<插图>
(1) 求三棱锥 $E-PAD$ 的体积；
(2) 证明：$AF\perp PE$。

handwriting_features: freehand wobbly solid and dashed lines with double-stroked segments
handwritten capital labels P, A, B, C, D, E, F matching the solution handwriting
handwritten x, y, z coordinate axes with freehand arrowheads
handwritten numeric annotations 2 and 4 on edges
figure_observations.observed_features: The drawing is entirely freehand pen work in the same black ink as the solution; no typeset labels, uniform thin printed lines, regular printed dashes, or printed caption are visible underneath. It is uncrossed and is explicitly referenced by the retained proof line 如图所示建立空间直角坐标系, so it serves as the student's retained coordinate/setup diagram.

handwritten_answer.text:
(1) 解：$\because PA=AB=2$，$AD=4$
$\therefore S_{\triangle PAD}=2\times4\div2=4$
$\therefore h=2$
$\therefore V_{E-PAD}=\frac{1}{3}Sh=\frac{1}{3}\times4\times2=\frac{8}{3}$
(2) 证明：$\because PA\perp$ 平面 $ABCD$
又 $\because AB$，$CB\subset$ 平面 $ABCD$
$\therefore PA\perp BC$
$\because PA=AB$
$\therefore \triangle PAB$ 为等腰三角形
$\because F$ 为 $PB$ 中点
$\therefore AF\perp BP$
如图所示建立空间直角坐标系，$A$ 为原点
$\because PA=AB=2$，$AD=4$
$\therefore P(0,0,2)$，$C(4,2,0)$，$A(0,0,0)$，$F(0,1,1)$
$\therefore \overrightarrow{PC}=(4,2,-2)$，$\overrightarrow{AF}=(0,1,1)$
$\therefore \cos\theta=\frac{\overrightarrow{PC}\cdot\overrightarrow{AF}}{|\overrightarrow{PC}||\overrightarrow{AF}|}=0$
$\therefore PC\perp AF$
$\because PB$，$PC\subset$ 平面 $PBC$，$PB\cap PC=P$
$\therefore AF\perp$ 平面 $PBC$
$\because PE\subset$ 平面 $PBC$ $\therefore PE\perp AF$

Struck-through strokes visible in the answer area are already excluded from the draft, and no retained step conflicts with the draft transcription.
